items.item_text: Healthcare wellness fellowship or certificate program (e.g., the Stanford Chief Wellness Officer Course or similar executive training).
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.

Nine (9) years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus five (5) years of related experience/training. Related experience: physician wellness, health and wellness, health management, health promotion or related fields; in-depth knowledge of the principles and practices of physician health and wellness administration.
Masters or PhD highly preferred.
Knowledge and experience surrounding change management, Lean Six Sigma and process improvement with a proven track record of addressing complex, multi-dimensional issues.
Experience working in an Academic Medical Center or other large multi-campus healthcare organization.

The Physician Wellness Program Manager will play an integral support role towards promoting advancing an extraordinary culture of physician wellness at UCSD, within a team that helps design, implement and evaluate physician wellness initiatives. The incumbent in this position will support the Physician Wellness Office.

Technical leader with a high degree of knowledge in the overall field and recognized expertise in specific areas; problem-solving frequently requires analysis of unique issues/problems without precedent and/or structure. May manage programs that include formulating strategies and administering policies, processes, and resources; functions with a high degree of autonomy.
Supports Physician Wellness Office through:
Management of UCSD Physician Wellness website
Analytic support for internal and select external Physician Wellness initiatives, with focus on measures of desired impact through process and outcome metrics

Streamlines scheduling and communication with internal Physician Wellness groups: including but not limited to Wellness Oversight, the Department Wellness Director Committee, Wellness Alignment Committee and other liaison committees.
Works with external wellness consultant to facilitate assessments and implement improvements
Serves as a key ambassador for the UCSD Physician Wellness Office through:
Active efforts to overcome institutional inertia causing slow progress toward goal
Effective liaison activities with other organizational wellness efforts to ensure wellness efforts are aligned and complimentary
Leadership in select cross-functional teams, as needed, to overcome inertia and/or solve complex organizational issues
Collaborative partnerships with executive leaders, department chairs and national wellness leaders to continually identify and support wellness efforts within their departments
Coordinates key fiscal reporting, including the Physician Wellness Office budget and Department Wellness Director resources.
Suggest duty modifications that maximize role efficacy
Other duties as assigned.
Responsive, adaptable and engaged in efforts to advance UCSD Physician Wellness initiatives.
Project management, change management or other certifications of relevance.
Advanced knowledge of the organizational development and effectiveness field, theories, models to assess, design and implement customized, strategic organization interventions.
Expert skills in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Agentic Ai programs Lean six sigma black belt.
Excellent ability to communicate efficiently and effectively in both written and verbal presentations at all levels with a professional demeanor.
Strong ability to build effective relationships with stakeholders of all levels, including staff, Directors, Administrators, Executives, and external partners.
Demonstrates strong analytical, problem-solving, project planning and implementation skills.
Highly skilled in facilitation, consulting and relationship building.
Applies strong verbal, written communication and presentation skills.
Possesses strong consulting, relationship building, and strategic thinking skills.
Demonstrates skill consulting to managers and groups at all levels.
Ability to coach, facilitate and influence people at all levels.
Demonstrates ability to learn quickly, reason, synthesize and generalize based on information obtained; sound judgment; ability to draw unbiased conclusions.
Ability to focus on priorities, strategies, and vision.
Knowledge of the consulting process to effectively lead engagements from inception to conclusion.
Ability to persuade through both logic and appeal to positive motivations.
